Noah Kim: Heads-up 1: NimbleHW + Marketplace joint-demo next Tue. Need clear SI claim flow + a quick account-mapping rule so demos don't get orphaned. Any volunteers for intake?

Priya Singh: I can take APAC/ROW intake for the pilot. What's our claim TTL?

Lee Patel: Recommend 18h claim TTL for pilot (faster than usual). Mapping rule idea: if lead.requested_products includes a hardware SKU -> route to hardware SI queue; else apply ARR/seats thresholds.

Maria Chen: Agree on SKU routing. Also require that SI is in our co-sell roster before they can claim. Ops: add roster check to automation.

Marketplace Ops Bot: Quick scan: 2 new demo requests flagged as Nimble-A100 bundle. Preview: https://go.redwood/preview/1746234567

Priya Singh: Action items: Ops add roster-check + 18h claim TTL, Lee add SKU rule to playbook, Maria update co-sell roster doc. I'll own follow-ups for APAC.

Lee Patel: Will PR the minimal mapping change.

Noah Kim: Great. If any disputed ownership, post to #partnerships-triage and tag me.

Maria Chen: sgtm, thanks everyone :handshake:
